scope: Beta.10 round 2 on codex/beta10-round2 (from codex/beta10-integration 96ab756a, later merged with d64fdc0d: within pin 3b5b9b9a and PPML separation activation): P5a exact pass fusion of the three-FE MAP pilot sweep (kept); P5b dense many-FE route choice (measured, refuted, not implemented); P6 fast-mode residency (measured, design only); E6c implicit LevelIndex (skipped); Ordered additive-Schwarz reduction in every mode (kept, coordinator request). Descriptive Mac evidence, not qualification.

artifacts.build: cargo build --profile profiling -p fereg-plugin --target aarch64-apple-darwin; clang -c stplugin.c/stata_bridge.c; clang -bundle with plugin/exports_macos.txt; ad-hoc codesign

inputs.generator: bench/campaign.py make_dataset, seed 739391, OLS cells of configurations(), 1M rows, 16 controls, vce(unadjusted)

protocol: Mac M2 Ultra (shared with other agents), Stata MP 19 batch, 3 fits per session, medians of fits 2-3 of native seconds (e(fereg_runtime) row 20), FEREG_PHASE_TIMING=1 FEREG_SOLVER_TRACE=1; frozen rule: 30 s without any other stata/cargo/rustc/python process before each session, 2 s sampling during it, discard and repeat once on a competitor. One early fused session (t4) was contaminated twice and is excluded; every session below was clean. Peak memory is /usr/bin/time -l maximum resident set of the Stata process; load-only processes: 208.7 MB (akm), 210.5 MB (three-sparse).

p5a_fused_pilot_sweep.mechanism: next effect's column scales raised in the row-streaming subtract pass (per-lane maximum tables merged by maximum); member-order weight and scaled sums unchanged; tables optional admitted scratch (<= 64 columns, <= 256 KiB per lane table)
p5a_fused_pilot_sweep.notes: Three-sparse predicts no pilot (geometry None) and is unaffected. Stata e(b), e(V) hashes, rss and r2 identical in every session.
p5a_fused_pilot_sweep.exactness: unit tests: fused vs unfused sweeps bit for bit (values and coefficient batches, unit/provided weights, 1/5/18/64 columns, crossed/random/sorted designs, forward/symmetric) at 1/2/4/8 workers with cross-worker agreement; whole pilot attempts (1/18/65 columns, three checkpoints, retained coefficients) identical to the unfused arm; refused tables keep the unfused pilot. Plugin replay 74/74 exact against beta.9 (before the integration merge).

p5b_dense_route.candidate: start the Jacobi LSMR trial instead of the geometry-qualified MAP pilot (measurement stub behind a hidden arm, removed)
p5b_dense_route.three_sparse: geometry predicts no pilot; any pilot-versus-trial rule leaves it on the trial
p5b_dense_route.decision: not implemented: the pilot is 25-38% faster and about 450 MB lighter where the geometry admits it, and the bounded pilot cannot certify where the geometry predicts no sweep count; no general rule improves on the qualified geometry policy on the campaign cells

p6_fast_residency.post_projection_readers_of_prepared_sour: the independent raw residual y - Xb (prepared_fit::build_independent_raw_residuals through NumericOlsColumns::subtract_fitted), used for the reported intercept mean (RawResiduals::MeanOnly), and requested xb/residual outputs; the row-major [y, X] copy is projected in place and holds no raw X afterwards
p6_fast_residency.decision: not implemented: every option either changes the independent raw residual's arithmetic or witness role (intercept from cached raw moments), or changes the public memory/transaction design (re-reading X through SPI after the solve, about 0.06-0.09 s per 1M x 17 values); keeping a raw row-major copy instead of the column-major sources saves nothing. An exact option outside P6: the three-FE pilot holds the original row-major matrix beside its candidate copy (144 B/row) only for the LSMR fallback; rebuilding the original from the column-major sources on a pilot miss would lower dense three-FE peaks by about 144 B/row without changing estimates or memory(auto).

e6c_level_index.survey: 149 production members()/checked_members() call sites, 13 membership_offsets() sites, 28 &[usize] member parameters in kernels.rs/ordered.rs including the installed hardware function-pointer types; a u32 or implicit-identity index cannot return &[usize] without storage and needs those signatures changed together

ordered_reduction.change: fe::lsmr::additive_schwarz: Ordered reduction for every additive-Schwarz build (OLS borrowed/owned LSMR, Jacobi-trial escalation, explicit preconditioner(schwarz), PPML joint Schwarz); previously only deterministic/PPML-deterministic

three_sparse_public_auto_native_auto_vs_.note: Jacobi trial finishes in 22-23 iterations per RHS; no escalation, additive solver not built; identical bits

three_sparse_explicit_lsmr_schwarz_nativ.note: identical bits under both reductions and across 1/4/8 workers on this design

ordered_reduction.cost: within noise (-2.3% to +2.3%); far below 5% of native time
ordered_reduction.witnesses: an escalating default-mode many-FE fit (shuffled near-confounded 60,000-row panel) repeats bit for bit at 1/2/4/8 workers and its retained solver reports the Ordered reduction; replay of the candidate against the Auto-reduction build of the same tree is 74/74 exact with 2/4/8-thread science and repeats
ordered_reduction.replay_vs_beta9: 59/74 exact; the 14 within-fused cases pass under tests/replay/scopes/2026-10-28-within-fused-lsmr-macos.json; ppml-separation-ir differs in RSEP[22] and RREC[28..29], the declared change of the integrated PPML separation activation; no science or discrete differences
